official_definition: You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost. Then, you can send two cores from any of your "Chronos" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, your counter or the opposing counter gets -2.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Time Unleash] or [Time Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Time Unleash]", "give [Time Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
